stem: Meena plants a small sapling in her school garden in Lucknow. After one year, she observes that it is very short, has a soft green stem, and no woody branches. How should Meena classify this plant?

options.text: Tree, because all garden plants grow into trees
Shrub, because it has many woody stems near the ground
Herb, because it is small with a soft green stem
Climber, because it needs support to stand upright

teacher.key_rationale: A plant that is small with a soft green stem and no woody branching is classified as a herb. Option A traps students who assume any garden plant becomes a tree; B wrongly requires woody stems (a shrub feature); D wrongly assumes weak stem/climbing behaviour not described in the stem.
